description: Derived from AGSC-05-09: the `@context` of `graph.jsonld` names the context version, a constant `1.0.0` at every version 1.x, and not the ontology version of AGSC-05-25. The case builds the same one-item Bundle twice, once with the vocabulary file reporting the ontology version `1.0.0` and once `1.1.0`: both documents name `https://w3id.org/agentic-system-core/ns/1.0.0/context.jsonld` and are byte-identical, so raising the ontology version changes no byte of any `graph.jsonld`.
